newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANK BOS TO START BOURSE TRADE ON FEB 3.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANK BOS TO START BOURSE TRADE ON FEB 3.

text.p: Poland's Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS), whose November public offering was heavily oversubscribed, will start trade on the main market of the Warsaw bourse on February 3, the bourse said in a statement.
The Friday statement said 10.6 million shares would enter bourse trade.
In November the firm sold 1.2 million shares at 29 zlotys each at its public offering.
The bourse also said that 1.5 million Amerbank shares approved for trade last week would enter the parallel market on January 31.
In an issue last September and October investors subscribed for 228,135 shares of the 1.5 million Amerbank shares available at 21 zlotys each, and underwriters took the rest.
